chapter_title: The Chapter of the Elements that wept
spiritual_reading:
#
 The Four
 Gri
efs of External
 Truth


**
¶2.
** The external
 truths that
 proceed
 from the Lord
 as Divine
 Truth —
 the ou
termost forms
 of wisdom
 that
 clothe and
 protect the inter
iors of the mind — perceived
 with
 grief the
 state
 of spiritual things
 three times. Then
 they were at
 rest
.
 But
 a fourth grief
 remains
, for they will perce
ive devast
ation once
 more
 at the final
 consummation. After that, their
 grief can
 cease entirely
, and
 they will never again suffer
 such
 perception
 from
 that
 time forward.

**¶3
.** The first grief was
 this
: when those
 external truths perceived the full
 nature
 of falsity and evil m
assing to
 assault them,
 they understood in
 advance
 everything
 that must
 be
fall them. They perceived
 the whole
 power
 of the opposition
 that
 would rise
 against them.
 Yet
 by
 divine necessity they advanced into conflict
 with that
 evil
 and
 cont
ended against
 it.
 They mas
tered it.
 They rest
rained it. They encomp
assed and
 bound fals
ity and
 evil within the
 full
 extent and
 articulation of their
 own forms — truth wr
apping
 itself around
 what
 is
 false
 —
 and
 by
 doing
 so they overcame spiritual death, the
 consuming
 fire
 of self-love, and the
 entire
 domin
ion of falsity.

**
¶4.** The second grief was
 this: when the Lord as
 in
most Divine
 Truth withdrew up
ward out
 of the deepest states of falsity
 and
 evil, He
 left those
 external truths behind.
 That is to
 say, He
 put
 off
 those
 ou
termost forms and
 departed
 from them
,
 leaving them
 in the midst of opposition. When
 those external truths perceived that
 the
 Divine
 had risen
 out
 of the abyss of
 falsity and had
 withdrawn
 His
 inmost presence from
 them —
 that they
 were left alone amid
 host
ility — they grieved and were st
ricken in
 their
 interior
 will
. Yet what
 could
 they do?
 They surrend
ered their will
 to every
 affliction. They remained behind and grew
 sick under the crushing
 weight of all the lab
ors of
 spiritual
 combat
, sust
aining this
 burden
 through
 all
 the ages
 until the appointed cons
ummation.

**¶5
.** The third grief was this:
 when the Lord
 operating
 through the spiritual degree took
 up certain
 active
 external truths and established
 them as the
 foundation
 beneath all things, He
 gave the remaining truths a perception
 —
 a sign — to lift
 their understanding
 and
 asp
ire toward
 interior
 states,
 to rise
 from
 that condition
, and to pass through every
 natural plane
 of
 the
 mind
 until they should reach the celest
ial state of tran
quility,
 peace
, and rest that
 had
 been prepared for them. But
 when they
 perceived that
 He
 too
 had separated
 Himself from them, while they themselves
 remained behind and
 had not yet
 ascended — at that moment these
 three forms
 of active
 truth griev
ed. Yet
 after their grief
, they turned their interior
 will
 toward all the elevated
 states that had
 been concealed from them, and
 they became
 unified in purpose
. For
 they knew
 they
 would rise
 and att
ain those
 interior
 states, passing
 beyond
 every
 natural condition,
 until
 the time that was ordained for the
 cons
ummation of all things.

**
¶6.** The fourth grief
 is
 this: when
 the complete Divine Human Form — the composite
 of all
 regenerated minds
 united
 as
 one
 — is perfected and taken up on
 the last day, these
 external truths will
 grieve for the
 minds
 that profaned truth and blas
phemed against
 the Divine. For
 portions
 of their own
 substance
 —
 their
 own
 spiritual
 lim
bs — have
 been severed and
 lost
 to fals
ity. And
 those prof
aning
 minds
 themselves
, when the perf
ected Divine
 Human Form asc
ends and
 they are left utt
erly alone, will cry
 out in anguish,
 for they will remain
 behind
 in
 affliction without
 end
.
 They
 are
 cut
 off and
 separated from that
 ultimate
 Divine
 Form. And it is an
 in
escapable consequence
 of spiritual
 law
 that those minds
 confirmed
 in evil
 are
 given
 over to the
 destruction
 they
 have
 chosen
,
 as
 the
 just
 correspondence
 of
 what
 they have done.
 They enter
 into
 fals
ity and are bound together
 with fals
ity forever
 — precisely
 as they desired it
,
 loved it, and placed their ruling
 love within
 it. At
 the
 very
 moment when the perf
ected Divine Human Form rises, they will
 cry
 out, they
 will sc
ream al
oud, because
 they are
 severed from the communion
 of that
 great Form. And they remain
 behind forever. This 
anguish is terrible beyond
 measure:
 it comes
 upon
 those minds
 who
 are given
 over to destruction
 in
 exact
 correspondence with their works
. And they will gr
ieve with that grief
 and
 never
 be silent, because
 rest
 will not reach
 them from that
 time forward.

**¶7
.** Thus
 also
 those
 external truths —
 the
 ou
termost forms of the
 Divine proce
eding through
 all
 the elements
 of creation
 — share
 in this fourth grief,
 and
 it
 r
ends them
 at
 the very
 center
 of
 their will
. It
 is far
 worse for them than the three
 preceding
 griefs. For
 this fourth grief is not for
 themselves. They
 grieve and are st
ricken in their in
most will on
 behalf of those minds
 who
 are
 cut
 off from peace forever
 —
 because
 rest will never
 come to those
 minds
, and
 they will never
 be
 released
 from tor
ment through
 all
 et
ernity.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The garments, the sons of the First Man, wept bitterly three times. Then they were silent. There is a fourth time of weeping, for they will weep at the end. And then their crying can stop, and they will never again weep from this time on.

Now, the first time of their weeping is when they had seen the Darkness, the enemy being about to burst out against them. They understood everything that would happen to them. They were aware of the one that would rise and come upon them, but by necessity they hastened to him and fought with him. They mastered him, they detained him. They bound him with their body and their limbs, they overcame his death and his fire and his Darkness.

[The] second time that they wept is [when the]ir father, the First Man, [ascend]ed from the [abyss] of Darkness and left them behind; that is the time when he stripped [them off] and left them below. Indeed, when th[ey] s[aw] how the First Man had risen out of the abyss and [l]eft them behind, and that they were abandoned in the enmit[y, th]ey wept and were sore of heart. Still, what could they do, wishing [to ascend after him? By necessity they gave] their heart to every affliction. They [remained b]ehind and grew [s]ick under the pressure of the weighty burden of all the works, until the end time.

[The] third time that they wept is when the Living Spirit stripped off the three garments of activity, placing them beneath all things. He gave them a sign to lift their heads and rise to the heights from that place; and to pass and journey through all the earths until they should reach the land of tranquilli[t]y and peace, the place of rest prepared for them. So, when they had seen him, that he had separated himself from them, while they themselves remained behind after him and had not ascended; at that moment when they stayed behind these three garments wept. After their crying, they turned their [hear]t to all the heights that were concealed from them, and were of one mind. For [they would] soar up and come to the heights; and pass over all things until the time that was ordained for them all [to come to pass] at the end of the worlds.

[The f]ourth time when they will weep is when the [S]tatue will be taken up on the last day, and they will weep [for] the souls of the liars and blasphemers; for they may give [no rest to them] because their limbs have been severed [and swallowed in the midst] of the Darkness. And also [th]ose souls, when the Statue will go up and they are left alo[n]e, they will weep in that they will rema[in] behind in affliction for ever. For they wi[ll be cut off] and separated from the Last Statue. An[d it is] a necessity to take these souls who are ready for loss as retribution for the deeds that they have done. They go i[n to] this [darkne]ss and are bound with the Darkness; just as they desired it and loved it, and placed their treasure with it. At that very moment, when the Last Statue rises up, the[y wi]ll weep. And then they will scream out loud because they will be severed from the company of this great Statue. And they remain behind for ever. This great weeping [of the last day] is terrible, it occurs in front of the souls and [the spirits] who are ready for loss in accordance with their deeds. And they [will] weep with that crying, they will never be silent; because they will not attain rest from this time on.

So, they too are the garments of these elements. This fourth time of weeping is heart-rending for them. It is much worse for them than these other three times of weeping before. This fourth time the weeping is not for themselves. Rather they weep and are heartsore for these soul[s] who will be cut off from peace, because rest will not come about for them, to allow them to rest from torment for ever.
